name: ChainOfResponsibility
summary: Avoids coupling the sender of a request to its receiver by giving several objects a chance to handle it, passing the request along the chain until one handles it.

roles.name: Handler
roles.summary: Declares the handling operation and, usually, the link to the successor.

roles.name: ConcreteHandler
roles.summary: Handles the requests it is responsible for, and forwards the others to its successor.
